intro: You can't fake product taste in an interview — you build it by using products closely and reading people who think about them well. Start here.

items.name: Lenny's Newsletter
items.what: The default PM newsletter. Growth, career, frameworks.

items.name: Stratechery
items.what: Ben Thompson on tech strategy and business models. Free Monday article.

items.name: The Product Person / Reforge blog
items.what: Deeper essays on product and growth work.

items.name: Product Hunt
items.what: New products daily. Good for spotting patterns and forming opinions.

items.name: TechCrunch
items.what: Funding, launches, shutdowns. Skim the headlines.

items.name: The Ken / Entrackr
items.what: India startup coverage with actual analysis.

items.name: Mobbin
items.what: Screenshots of real app flows, searchable. Study onboarding and checkout.

items.name: Dribbble
items.what: UI concepts. Useful for vocabulary, less for real product thinking.

items.name: Growth.Design
items.what: Case studies that pull apart one flow at a time.

items.name: Mode SQL Tutorial
items.what: Learn enough SQL to pull your own numbers. One weekend.

items.name: Exponent (free content)
items.what: Question lists and some free walkthroughs.

items.name: Product Management Exercises
items.what: Community answers to real interview questions, by company.

items.name: Lenny's Podcast
items.what: Long interviews with working PMs and founders.

items.name: Acquired
items.what: Deep company histories. Great for pattern-matching business models.
